newsitem.title: USA: Home State names Vaughn president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Home State names Vaughn president, CEO.

text.p: Home State Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it named Mark Vaughn president and chief executive officer and Eric Reehl executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Vaughn had been acting president and CEO and Reehl had been acting CFO since June, the company said.

The men had been responsible for developing a business plan which included planned growth of target markets, reviewing and strengthening financial reserves and raising capital through an initial $10 million preferred stock placement.
Vaughn was previously senior vice president of marketing and underwriting and Reehl was previously director of corporate development.
